meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 为项目接入 Discord 机器人:从 channels 分支复制适配器、注册通道、安装 @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0 并跑构建与注册测试;之后引导创建机器人、粘贴 Bot Token,自动推导应用 ID 与公钥写入 .env,重启服务并打通私信通道。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 项目加 Discord 机器人通道时触发——主干不自带通道,技能从 channels 分支把适配器复制进来;若正在 /setup 流程中,则接回该流程继续。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人接入这个项目
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并跑构建与注册测试。

say.text: 我拿到 Bot Token 了,继续配 Discord 凭据
say.note: 粘贴后自动推导应用 ID 与公钥写入 .env。

say.text: 重启服务,让 Discord 适配器生效
say.note: 重启后机器人可在私信里收到消息。

howto.what_en: Copies the Discord adapter in from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/discord@4.29.0, builds and runs the registration test, then guides bot creation, Bot Token paste, and a service restart.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Discord bot channel to a NanoClaw project; the trunk ships no channels, so the adapter is copied from the channels branch. Inside /setup, it returns to that flow.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot channel to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, builds and tests.

say_en.text: I have the Bot Token — continue the Discord credentials setup
say_en.note: Derives App ID and Public Key into .env.

say_en.text: Restart the service so the Discord adapter loads
say_en.note: Waits for the CLI socket, then DMs work.
